name: Weissenhofmuseum im Haus Le Corbusier
funding: The Friends of the Weissenhof Estate run the museum in a city-owned house. Stuttgart's culture office granted EUR 375,000 a year for 2024 and 2025. Wüstenrot Stiftung joined the restoration.

name: Haus Hohe Pappeln
funding: Klassik Stiftung Weimar, 2024: federal EUR 14.6M, Thuringia 14.6M, Weimar 5.6M, own income 2.0M. LOTTO Thüringen, the state lottery, sponsored the Stiftung's 2023 and 2024 theme years.

name: Haus am Horn
funding: Klassik Stiftung Weimar, 2024: federal EUR 14.6M, Thuringia 14.6M, Weimar 5.6M, own income 2.0M. LOTTO Thüringen, the state lottery, sponsored the Stiftung's 2023 and 2024 theme years.

name: Skulpturenpark Waldfrieden
funding: The Cragg Foundation, set up by the Cragg family in 2005, runs the park Tony Cragg bought in 2006. The site names no funders or accounts and asks for donations.

name: Haus Rabe
funding: Kulturstiftung Landkreis Leipzig, set up by the district, bought the house with federal money. Its Supported by logos show the federal culture commissioner, Kulturraum Leipziger Raum and Zwenkau town.

name: Walter Rózsi Villa
funding: The Hungarian Academy of Arts, paid from the state budget, funds the Museum of Architecture (MÉM MDK) that runs the villa and financed its 2020 to 2022 renovation.

name: Heroes' Acre (Windhoek)
funding: Namibian government paid Mansudae N$60 million against a N$34 million budget. Opened 26 August 2002. The National Heritage Council runs it; adult Namibians paid N$50 in 2024-25.

name: Independence Memorial Museum
funding: Paid for by the Namibian government and built by Mansudae from 2009; it opened in March 2014. Entry is free and a culture ministry heritage official speaks for it.

name: Huis Van Zessen
funding: Owned by the EFL Stichting, whose only 2024 income was a EUR 700k net investment result. Visitors' voluntary contributions pay for the house's maintenance and volunteers.

name: Atelier Volten
funding: Subsidies were EUR 24.7k of EUR 60.6k income in 2025. Gemeente Amsterdam gives permanent subsidy. 2025 show funders: Amsterdam-Noord, Cultuurfonds Noord-Holland, Gifted Art, BPD, Jaap Harten Fonds, Kattendijke/Drucker Stichting.

name: Museum Het Schip
funding: Income EUR 1.55M in 2025: Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst EUR 493k, Amsterdamse Federatie van Woningcorporaties EUR 110k, earned income EUR 710k. Mondriaan Fonds and Gemeente Amsterdam add project grants.

name: Van Eesteren Museum
funding: Structural funders: Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst, Stadsdeel Nieuw-West, Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie. EFL Stichting gives EUR 65k a year. Government subsidies were EUR 394k of EUR 609k income in 2025.
